name: The Long Road Ahead
source:
This is a short creepy tale inspired by Chinese culture. 

It tells the tale of Liang and Ying as they travel back to Liang's hometown. During their journey home, a dark presence looms close by.

[From [url=https://cellar-vault-games.itch.io/the-long-road-ahead] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个受中国文化启发的短篇诡异故事。

故事讲述梁与莹在返回梁的故乡的旅程中，某种黑暗存在一直在他们身边徘徊。

[来源：[url=https://cellar-vault-games.itch.io/the-long-road-ahead]itch.io[/url]]
